title: Pat Price's death linked to psychokinesis program

tellings.quote: think the reason Pat Price wound up dead is that he was recruited into that program and tasked with certain operations and he wound up having serious moral reservations to that.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani believes that a man named Pat Price died because of a secret programme on psychokinesis, the supposed power to move or affect things with the mind. Jorjani tells Michels he thinks Price was recruited into that programme, given 'certain operations', and then developed 'serious moral reservations', and that this is why he 'wound up dead'. If he is right, a 1970s mind-power programme would have cost one of its own people his life.
